text: Xero Limited is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange and is a New Zealand incorporated and domiciled company; its FY26 annual report's Top 20 holders list as at 9 April 2026 is headed by custody nominees — HSBC Custody Nominees (Australia) Limited (29.44%), J P Morgan Nominees Australia Pty Limited (23.20%) and Citicorp Nominees Pty Limited (16.43%).
short: Xero is ASX-listed; register headed by custody nominees

source.name: Xero Limited Annual Report 2026 (PDF), Company and reporting information / Top 20 holders
source.quote: Xero is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX) and is a New Zealand incorporated and domiciled company.
source.note: Same report, 'Top 20 holders' (p.86): 'The names of the 20 largest holders of Xero shares as at 9 April 2026 are listed below', headed by HSBC Custody Nominees (Australia) Limited 50,226,280 shares, 29.44% of issued capital. All of the top three entries are custody nominees; the largest entry in the table that is not a custody nominee is 'MR RODNEY KENNETH DRURY & MR SCOTT MORAN' at 2.16%.
